title: Watrana Rentals IPO Details
intro:
Watrana Rentals IPO is a book build issue of ₹120.10 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 49.02 lakh shares of ₹120.10 crore.

Watrana Rentals IPO opens for subscription on Nov 19, 2026 and closes on Nov 23, 2026. The allotment for the Watrana Rentals IPO is expected to be finalized on Nov 25, 2026. Watrana Rentals IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Nov 27, 2026.

Watrana Rentals IPO is set issue price band at ₹232 to ₹245 per share. The lot size for an application is 600 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,94,000 (1,200 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (1,800 shares), amounting to ₹4,41,000.

Oneview Corporate Advisors Pvt.ltd. is the book running lead manager and Maashitla Securities Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Basan Equity Broking Ltd.

Refer to Watrana Rentals IPO RHP for detailed Information.

faqs.question: How to apply in Watrana Rentals IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply for the Watrana Rentals IPO online through the Kite platform under the IPO & Bids section using UPI as the payment method. Steps to Apply for Watrana Rentals IPO through Zerodha Log in to your Zerodha Kite account. On the home page, click IPO & Bids in the top menu. Select the IPO tab and find the Watrana Rentals IPO in the list. Click Apply next to the IPO. Enter your UPI ID, bid quantity, and bid price. Submit the IPO application. Open your UPI app and approve the mandate to complete the application process. For more details, visit the Zerodha IPO Application Process Review .
